statusModel.legacyField: 'status' is retained on every row for backward compatibility only. It is DERIVED and may lag the four fields below — treat it as a convenience summary, not the source of truth.
statusModel.implementationStatus: Code-existence axis. One of: missing | partial | implemented | approved | notApplicable. 'approved' means implemented AND visual-compliance-approved (the terminal state).
statusModel.visualComplianceStatus: Figma-fidelity-check axis. One of: pending | verified | approved | notApplicable. 'verified' = live Figma data has been captured/compared but not yet formally logged in docs/COMPONENT_APPROVAL_MATRIX.md; 'approved' = formally logged there.
statusModel.officialCoverage: How much of the official component's variant/sub-part surface the FADS implementation covers. One of: complete | partial | unknown | notApplicable. 'unknown' whenever nothing is implemented yet, or (for Notification) when the official-vs-FADS structural mapping itself is unresolved.
statusModel.nodeResolutionStatus: Figma canvas node lookup axis. One of: resolved | pending | blocked | notApplicable. See each row's 'nodeResolutionPlan' for why/how/blocked-or-not detail (Task 5 of the 2026-07-12 hardening pass).

registryNotes.duplicatePolicy: Rows with isDuplicate:true are EXCLUDED from all canonical component counts (see docs/COUNTING_METHODOLOGY.md).
